node_definition.done_when: A test in a temporary RECKON_HOME and repository shows the following. A scopes call without candidates reports unevaluated, while a disjoint supplied candidate reports evaluated with empty conflicts. A stopped, clean claim is marked non-binding and a running claim binding, each matching dispatch's own disposition for that path. Giving the stopped tree an unintegrated commit makes its claim binding. Tests naming the scopes view, scope claims or _repository_scope_claims are recorded as flat baseline_suite and after_suite records.
node_definition.goal: Make the scopes view say what it evaluated and whether each claim binds, per the census at docs/evidence/fragments/crew-observability-truth/dispatch-refusal-surface-census.html rows nine and ten. A scopes call with no candidate returns an explicit unevaluated state, distinct from an evaluated call with empty conflicts. Each listed claim carries a binding flag computed by the same rule dispatch applies: a stopped run with no unintegrated work at its declared paths is non-binding, a running claim is binding.
